title: Notice to all Cigarette Manufacturers
text:
MISSISSIPPI DEPARTMENT OF REVENUE
Sales and Use Tax Bureau Notice 72-26-05 May 7, 2026
Notice to all Cigarette Manufacturers
Pursuant to Miss. Code Ann. Section 75-101-3 et seq., each manufacturer of cigarettes whose
products are sold into Mississippi, whether directly or through an importer, wholesaler, distributor,
retailer, or similar intermediary, shall execute a certification form and submit it to the Department of
Revenue with applicable fees and documentation prior to September 1, 2026, and each year
thereafter.
Both initial certifications and annual recertifications will be submitted to the Department of Revenue
through Taxpayer Access Point (TAP). The manufacturer shall separately list each brand family,
which means all styles of cigarettes under the same trademark and differentiated from one another by
means of additional modifiers or descriptors, including, but not limited to, “menthol,” “kings” and “100s,”
and includes any brand name, trademark, logo, symbol, motto, selling message, recognizable pattern
of colors or any other indicia of product identification identical or similar to, or identifiable with, a
previously known brand of cigarettes.
Each initial certification and annual recertification must include the following:
1) A list of the manufacturer’s brand families that are sold in Mississippi,
2) Verification that the manufacturer possesses all orders required by the United States Food
and Drug Administration for the manufacture and sale of the cigarettes included in the
manufacturer’s brand families; all orders submitted must be current,
3) Verification that the manufacturer is registered to do business in this state or has a resident
agent for service of process; and
4) A payment of Five Hundred Dollars ($500.00) for each cigarette product each time a
manufacturer submits an annual certification form for that cigarette product, but not to
exceed Fifteen Thousand Dollars ($15,000.00) annually per manufacturer.
Initial certifications and annual recertifications received by the annual September 1st deadline will be
reviewed and approved products will be placed on the Mississippi Cigarette Directory on October 1st.
The Mississippi Cigarette Directory will be updated monthly.
NO CIGARETTE PRODUCTS may be offered for sale in the State of Mississippi unless the product
is listed on the directory and the product meets all other requirements pursuant to law.
If you have any questions, please contact CigaretteDirectory@dor.ms.gov.
P.O. Box 1033 Jackson, Mississippi 39215 Phone: 601-923-7015 FAX: 601-923-7034
